title: Monthly Transactions II
sourceNote: AI-authored requirements draft local-reference/leetcode/manual/1205.txt; no recovered raw statement exists in the archive (index status missing-statement).
summary: For each month and country, report approved transactions by transaction date and chargebacks by chargeback date. A chargeback's amount is the amount of the transaction it refers to. Groups present in either stream are included.
inputFormat: Transactions(id, country, state, amount, trans_date); Chargebacks(trans_id, trans_date).
outputFormat: Per month and country: approved_count, approved_amount, chargeback_count, chargeback_amount. Exact column names need confirmation.
tieRules: No tie rule; ordering is not stated in the draft.
edgeRules: Groups appearing only in Chargebacks or only in Transactions must still appear; missing counts are zero.
